70200.meaning1: holding a braid; taking hold of a plait of hair

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthaggāhaṃ vā veṇiggāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅgh'ādiseso.

70201.meaning1: to card wool; to spin wool
70201.commentary: (ANa) veṇiṃ olikhitun'ti eḷakalomāni kappetvā vijaṭetvā veṇiṃ kātuṃ.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu otiṇṇo vipariṇatena cittena mātugāmena saddhiṃ kāyasaṃsaggaṃ samāpajjeyya hatthaggāhaṃ vā veṇiggāhaṃ vā aññatarassa vā aññatarassa vā aṅgassa parāmasanaṃ, saṅgh'ādiseso.
veṇī nāma suddhakesā vā, suttamissā vā, mālāmissā vā, hiraññamissā vā, suvaṇṇamissā vā, muttāmissā vā, maṇimissā vā.

70203.meaning2: plaited, bound together as in a sheaf

70206.meaning1: belonging to a family of bamboo workers

examples.text: āyantu pana bhonto ye tattha caṇḍālakulā nesādakulā veṇukulā rathakārakulā pukkusakulā uppannā, sāpānadoṇiyā vā sūkaradoṇiyā vā rajakadoṇiyā vā eraṇḍakaṭṭhassa vā uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattentu, tejo pātukarontū'ti.

70208.meaning2: tax to be paid in bamboo

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho veṇḍu devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
ye me pavutte siṭṭhipade (veṇḍū'ti bhagavā), anusikkhanti jhāyino, kāle te appamajjantā, na maccuvasagā siyun'ti.

70211.meaning1: name of a group of deities
70211.commentary: (DNa) veṇḍū ca devā'ti veṇḍudevatā ca. (DNt) veṇḍudevatā'ti veṇḍu nāma devatā, evaṃ sahali devatā.

examples.text: veṇḍudevā sahali ca, asamā ca duve yamā, candass'ūpanisā devā, candam'āguṃ purakkhatvā.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhito kho veṇhu devaputto bhagavato santike imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
sa kho so, bhikkhave, bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo na c'eva lābhī hoti acchādanassa, na lābhī vetanassa, na lābhī abhihārānaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?
rājabhoggo nāma yo koci rañño bhattavetan'āhāro.

70217.meaning1: name of a river in hell
70217.notes: Indian equivalent of the River Styx

examples.text: yo dhammaladdhassa dadāti dānaṃ, uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatassa jantu, atikkamma so vetaraṇiṃ yamassa, dibbāni ṭhānāni upeti macco'ti.

70220.meaning1: (comm) playing percussion instruments; (or) raising dead bodies with spells

examples.text: seyyath'idaṃ, naccaṃ gītaṃ vāditaṃ pekkhaṃ akkhānaṃ pāṇissaraṃ vetāḷaṃ kumbhathūṇaṃ sobhanakaṃ caṇḍālaṃ vaṃsaṃ dhovanaṃ hatthiyuddhaṃ assayuddhaṃ mahiṃsayuddhaṃ usabhayuddhaṃ ajayuddhaṃ meṇḍayuddhaṃ kukkuṭayuddhaṃ
dukkham'eva hi sambhoti, dukkhaṃ tiṭṭhati veti ca, n'āññatra dukkhā sambhoti, n'āññaṃ dukkhā nirujjhatī'ti.
attā me uppajjati ca veti cā'ti icc'assa evam'āgataṃ hoti. tasmā taṃ na upapajjati, cakkhu attā'ti yo vadeyya. iti cakkhu anattā.
haneyyuṃ vā'ti hatthena vā pādena vā kasāya vā vettena vā aḍḍhadaṇḍakena vā chejjāya vā haneyyuṃ.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.

70225.meaning1: bound by rigging; tied together with ropes

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, sāmuddikāya nāvāya vettabandhanabaddhāya vassamāsāni udake pariyādāya hem'antikena thalaṃ ukkhittāya vāt'ātapaparetāni vettabandhanāni.
yathodhi kho pan'assa cattaṃ hoti vantaṃ muttaṃ pahīnaṃ paṭinissaṭṭhaṃ, so buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgatomhī'ti labhati atthavedaṃ, labhati dhammavedaṃ, labhati dhamm'ūpasaṃhitaṃ pāmojjaṃ.
sayaṃ samādāya vatāni jantu, ucc'āvacaṃ gacchati saññasatto, vidvā ca vedehi samecca dhammaṃ, na ucc'āvacaṃ gacchati bhūripañño.
vedāni viceyya kevalāni, samaṇānaṃ yān'idh'atthi brāhmaṇānaṃ, sabbavedanāsu vītarāgo, sabbaṃ vedam'aticca vedagū so.
na vedagū diṭṭhiyā na mutiyā, sa mānam'eti na hi tam'mayo so, na kammunā no'pi sutena neyyo, anūpanīto sa nivesanesu.

70230.meaning2: Brahmanic canon of authorised religious teaching
70230.notes: (Apte) ṛgveda, yajurveda and sāmaveda, which are collectively called trayī 'the sacred triad'; but a fourth, the atharvaveda, was subsequently added to them.

examples.text: tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako, veyyākaraṇo, lok'āyata-mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo.
pañcavedā sataṃ samaṃ, tapassī brāhmaṇā caraṃ, cittañ'ca nesaṃ na sammā vimuttaṃ, hīn'attharūpā na pāraṅ'gamā te.
nisabhassa appameyyassa, gambhīrassa monapattassa, khemaṅ'karassa vedassa, dhammaṭṭhassa saṃvut'attassa, saṅgātigassa muttassa, bhagavato tassa sāvako'ham'asmi.

70233.meaning1: who has perfect knowledge; who has complete understanding
70233.meaning2: who has attained the highest knowledge
70233.commentary: (MNa) catumaggañāṇasaṅkhātehi vedehi akusaladhammānaṃ gatattā vedagū hoti, viditattā'ti attho. (THa) vedagū'ti vedena gato maggañāṇena nibbānaṃ gato adhigato, cattāri vā saccāni pariññā-pahāna-sacchikiriyā-bhāvan'ābhisamaya-vasena abhisamecca ṭhito. (SNa) jātu vedagū'ti ahaṃ ek'aṃsen'eva vedagū, vedasaṅkhātena ñāṇena neyyesu gato, vedaṃ vā gato adhigato, paṇḍito'ham'asmī'ti attho.

examples.text: sukhino vata ye akiñcanā, vedaguno hi janā akiñcanā, sakiñcanaṃ passa vihaññamānaṃ, jano janasmiṃ paṭibandhacitto.
pucchāmi taṃ bhagavā brūhi me taṃ, maññāmi taṃ vedaguṃ bhāvit'attaṃ, kuto nu dukkhā samudāgatā ime, ye keci lokasmim'anekarūpā.
etādisaṃ yaññam'anussarantā, ye vedajātā vicaranti loke, vineyya maccheramalaṃ samūlaṃ, aninditā saggam'upenti ṭhānan'ti.
so bāvarī attamano udaggo, taṃ devataṃ pucchati vedajāto, katamamhi gāme nigamamhi vā pana, katamamhi vā janapade lokanātho, yattha gantvāna passemu, sambuddhaṃ dvipad'uttamaṃ.

70236.commentary: (SNa) yathā yāgum'eva yāguttāya, pūvam'eva pūvattāya pacati

examples.text: rūpaṃ rūpattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, vedanaṃ vedanattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saññaṃ saññattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, saṅkhāre saṅkhārattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti, viññāṇaṃ viññāṇattāya saṅkhatam'abhisaṅkharonti
evam'eva kho, bho gotama, rūp'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo rūpe patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati, vedan'att'āyaṃ purisapuggalo vedan'āyaṃ patiṭṭhāya puññaṃ vā apuññaṃ vā pasavati

70238.meaning1: (pleasant, unpleasant or neutral) felt experience; feeling; feeling tone; hedonic tone; sensation (coming from six sense experience); second of the five aggregates

examples.text: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.
ajjhattañ'ca bahiddhā ca, vedanaṃ n'ābhinandato, evaṃ satassa carato, viññāṇaṃ uparujjhatī'ti.
vedanaṃ pharusaṃ jāniṃ, sarīrassa ca bhedanaṃ, garukaṃ vā'pi ābādhaṃ, cittakkhepañ'ca pāpuṇe.
so tattha dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti, na ca tāva kālaṅ'karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byantīhoti.
samudayan'ti-ādīsu avijjāsamudayā cakkhusamudayo'ti-ādinā vedanākammaṭṭhāne vuttanayena phass'āyatanānaṃ samuday'ādayo veditabbā.

70242.meaning1: classes of feeling; categories of felt experience

examples.text: cha'y'ime, bhikkhave, vedanākāyā, cakkhusamphassajā vedanā, sotasamphassajā vedanā, ghānasamphassajā vedanā, kāyasamphassajā vedanā, manosamphassajā vedanā.

70243.meaning1: aggregate of felt experience; mass of feeling; second of the five aggregates

examples.text: pañcakkhandhā, rūpakkhandho vedanākkhandho saññākkhandho saṅkhārakkhandho viññāṇakkhandho.

70244.meaning1: wearing away of feeling; exhaustion of (painful) sensation
70244.commentary: (ANa) dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo'ti dukkhavaṭṭakkhayena vedanākkhayo. dukkhavaṭṭasmiñ'hi khīṇe vedanāvaṭṭam'pi khīṇam'eva hoti.

examples.text: iti purāṇānaṃ kammānaṃ tapasā byantibhāvā, navānaṃ kammānaṃ akaraṇā, āyatiṃ anavassavo, āyatiṃ anavassavā kammakkhayo, kammakkhayā dukkhakkhayo, dukkhakkhayā vedanākkhayo, vedanākkhayā sabbaṃ dukkhaṃ nijjiṇṇaṃ bhavissatī'ti.

70245.meaning1: related to felt experience; connected with feeling; concerning sensation; kind of feeling
70245.commentary: (ANa) vedanāgat'ādīni sampayuttavedanādīnaṃ vasena veditabbāni (ANa) rūpam'eva rūpagataṃ. sesapadesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: so yadeva tattha hoti rūpagataṃ vedanāgataṃ saññāgataṃ saṅkhāragataṃ viññāṇagataṃ, te dhamme aniccato dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato parato palokato suññato anattato samanupassati.

70246.commentary: (ANa) rūp'aggan'ti yaṃ rūpaṃ sammasitvā arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti, idaṃ rūp'aggaṃ nāma. sesesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: katamāni cattāri? rūp'aggaṃ, vedanā'ggaṃ, saññā'ggaṃ, bhav'aggaṃ, imāni kho, bhikkhave, cattāri aggānī'ti.
taṇhā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavā.

70248.meaning1: one of the feelings; a certain felt experience (among)
70248.commentary: (MNa) vedan'āññataran'ti tīsu vedanāsu aññataraṃ, sukhavedanaṃ sandhāy'etaṃ vuttaṃ.

examples.text: vedanāsu vedan'āññatar'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadāmi yadidaṃ, assāsapassāsānaṃ sādhukaṃ manasikāraṃ. tasmā't'iha, bhikkhave, vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, thale kato udakaṃ ottharati, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, khittacittassa, vedan'āṭṭassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

70250.meaning1: having the ability to feel; sensate
70250.meaning2: having the ability to feel; sensate
70250.commentary: (DNa) attā me vediyati, vedanādhammo hi me attā'ti iminā saññā-saṅkhāra-viññāṇakkhandha-vatthukā. idañ'hi khandhattayaṃ vedanāsampayuttattā vediyati. etassa ca vedanādhammo avippayuttasabhāvo.

examples.text: na h'eva kho me vedanā attā, no'pi appaṭisaṃvedano me attā, attā me vediyati, vedanādhammo hi me attā'ti iti vā hi, ānanda, attānaṃ samanupassamāno samanupassati.

70251.meaning1: realm of feeling; world of sensation

examples.text: vedanādhātuyā… saññādhātuyā… saṅkhāradhātuyā ce bhikkhave… viññāṇadhātuyā ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno rāgo pahīno hoti, rāgassa pahānā vocchijjat'ārammaṇaṃ patiṭṭhā viññāṇassa na hoti.
vedanādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. vedanādhāturāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ, okasārī'ti vuccati.

70252.meaning1: bound by desire to the realm of feeling

examples.text: vedanādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko. vedanādhātu-rāgavinibandhañ'ca pana viññāṇaṃ okasārī'ti vuccati. saññādhātu kho, gahapati, viññāṇassa oko.

70253.meaning1: diversity of felt experiences; variety of feelings

examples.text: katame nava dhammā duppaṭivijjhā? nava nānattā, dhātunānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati phassanānattaṃ, phassanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati vedanānānattaṃ, vedanānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saññānānattaṃ, saññānānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati saṅkappanānattaṃ, saṅkappanānattaṃ paṭicca uppajjati chandanānattaṃ

70255.meaning1: fact of impermanence of feeling; fact of instability of felt experience

examples.text: vedanaṃ, bhikkhave, yoniso manasi karotha, vedan'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassatha. vedanaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu yoniso manasi karonto, vedan'āniccatañ'ca yathābhūtaṃ samanupassanto vedanāya nibbindati. nandikkhayā rāgakkhayo, rāgakkhayā nandikkhayo.
taṇhā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavā.

70257.meaning1: ending of feeling; cessation of felt experience

examples.text: channaṃ tv'eva, phagguna, phass'āyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā phassanirodho, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho
phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho.

70258.meaning1: path of practice leading to the end of felt experience

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

70259.meaning1: leading to the end of felt experience

examples.text: ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.

yato kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako vedanañ'ca pajānāti, vedanāsamudayañ'ca pajānāti, vedanānirodhañ'ca pajānāti, vedanānirodhagāminiṃ paṭipadañ'ca pajānāti, ettāvatā'pi kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti

70260.meaning1: following felt experience; contemplating feeling tone

examples.text: vedan'ānupassanā niṭṭhitā.

70261.meaning1: contemplating feeling; who observes felt experience
70261.commentary: (SNa) vedanāsū'ti ettha tisso vedanā, tā ca lokiyā eva, cittam'pi lokiyaṃ, tathā dhammā. yathā pana vedanā anupassitabbā, tathā anupassanto esa vedan'ānupassī'ti veditabbo.

examples.text: vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ
yasmiṃ samaye, bhikkhave, bhikkhu pītipaṭisaṃvedī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati… vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī, bhikkhave, tasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu viharati ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.

70262.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl sg of vedanāpaccaya
70262.meaning1: dependent on felt experience; due to sensation

examples.text: vedanāpaccayā taṇhā, taṇhāpaccayā upādānaṃ, upādānapaccayā bhavo, bhavapaccayā jāti, jātipaccayā jarāmaraṇaṃ

70263.meaning1: concept of felt experience; what is called sensation
70263.commentary: (MNa) phassapaññattiṃ paññapessatī'ti phasso nāma eko dhammo uppajjatī'ti evaṃ phassapaññattiṃ paññapessati, dassessatī'ti attho. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: phassapaññattiyā sati vedanāpaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati. vedanāpaññattiyā sati saññāpaññattiṃ paññāpessatī'ti, ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati.

70264.meaningLit: discourse on the question about feeling tone

70265.meaning1: produced by felt experience; generated by sensation

examples.text: taṇhā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavā.

70266.meaning1: imprisoned by feeling; held captive by felt sensation
70266.meaningLit: bound with the bond of feeling

examples.text: ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano vedanābandhanabaddho santarabāhirabandhanabaddho atīradassī apāradassī, baddho jīyati baddho mīyati baddho asmā lokā paraṃ lokaṃ gacchati.

70267.meaning1: suffering a feeling; afflicted by pain

examples.text: añño karoti añño paṭisaṃvedayatī'ti kho, kassapa, vedan'ābhitunnassa sato paraṃkataṃ dukkhan'ti iti vadaṃ ucchedaṃ etaṃ pareti.

70268.meaning1: taking pleasure in feeling; delighting in sensation

examples.text: vedan'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa, vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti

70269.meaning1: enjoying feeling tone; taking pleasure in sensation

examples.text: vedan'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa, vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti

70270.meaning1: freed by the exhaustion of feelings; liberated through the dissolution of felt experience

examples.text: vedanāsaṅkhayavimutto kho, vaccha, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāḷho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo. upapajjatī'ti na upeti, na upapajjatī'ti na upeti, upapajjati ca na ca upapajjatī'ti na upeti, n'eva upapajjati na na upapajjatī'ti na upeti.

70271.meaning1: free from classification in terms of feeling

examples.text: yāya vedanāya tathāgataṃ paññāpayamāno paññāpeyya, sā vedanā tathāgatassa pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tāl'āvatthukatā anabhāvaṅkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā. vedanāsaṅkhāyavimutto, mahārāja, tathāgato gambhīro appameyyo duppariyogāho, seyyathā'pi mahāsamuddo.

70272.meaning1: source of feeling; arising of feeling

examples.text: phassasamudayā vedanāsamudayo, phassanirodhā vedanānirodho.
cha'y'ime, āvuso, taṇhākāyā, rūpataṇhā, saddataṇhā, gandhataṇhā, rasataṇhā, phoṭṭhabbataṇhā, dhammataṇhā. vedanāsamudayā taṇhāsamudayo, vedanānirodhā taṇhānirodho

70273.meaning1: with felt experience as source; originating from feeling

examples.text: taṇhā c'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, kiṃnidānā kiṃsamudayā kiṃjātikā kiṃpabhavā? taṇhā vedanānidānā vedanāsamudayā vedanājātikā vedanāpabhavā.

70274.meaning1: leading to the arising of feeling

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, katamā nu kho, bhante, vedanā, katamo vedanāsamudayo, katamā vedanāsamudayagāminī paṭipadā? katamo vedanānirodho, katamā vedanānirodhagāminī paṭipadā?

70275.meaning1: converging upon feeling; coming together in sensation

examples.text: te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamudayā'ti? phassasamudayā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃsamosaraṇā'ti? vedanāsamosaraṇā, bhante'ti. te pana, samiddhi, kiṃpamukhā'ti? samādhippamukhā, bhante'ti.
chandamūlakā, āvuso, sabbe dhammā, manasikārasambhavā sabbe dhammā, phassasamudayā sabbe dhammā, vedanāsamosaraṇā sabbe dhammā

70276.meaning1: happy with feeling; pleased with felt sensation

examples.text: vedan'ārāmassa kho, āvuso, vedanāratassa vedanāsammuditassa, vedanānirodhaṃ ajānato apassato yathābhūtaṃ, hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā'ti'p'issa hoti …

70278.meaning1: one remains among feelings, closely observing feelings
70278.commentary: (PM) kathaṃ vedanāsu vedan'ānupassī viharati? idh'ekacco sukhaṃ vedanaṃ aniccato anupassati, no niccato… paṭinissajjati, no ādiyati. aniccato anupassanto niccasaññaṃ pajahati… paṭinissajjanto ādānaṃ pajahati. imehi sattahi ākārehi vedanaṃ anupassati. vedanā upaṭṭhānaṃ, no sati.

70283.meaning1: (understanding of the) subtlety of felt experience; fineness of feelings

examples.text: vedanāsokhummena samannāgato hoti paramena, tena ca vedanāsokhummena aññaṃ vedanāsokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na samanupassati, tena ca vedanāsokhummena aññaṃ vedanāsokhummaṃ uttaritaraṃ vā paṇītataraṃ vā na pattheti.
vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā vedanaṃ, vedanāya vā attānaṃ. ahaṃ vedanā, mama vedanā'ti pariyuṭṭhaṭṭhāyī hoti.
tassa vedanāvipariṇām'aññathābhāvā uppajjanti soka-parideva-dukkha-domanass'upāyāsā.

70286.meaning1: born from rolling around after the change of feeling

examples.text: tassa vedanāvipariṇām'aññathābhāvā vedanāvipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa vedanāvipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca upādāya ca paritassati.

70287.meaning1: rolling around after the change of feeling
70287.commentary: (SNa) rūpavipariṇām'ānuparivattiviññāṇaṃ hotī'ti mama rūpaṃ vipariṇatan'ti vā ahu vata m'etaṃ, dāni vata me n'atthī'ti vā ādinā nayena kammaviññāṇaṃ rūpassa bhed'ānuparivatti hoti.

examples.text: tassa vedanāvipariṇām'aññathābhāvā vedanāvipariṇām'ānuparivatti viññāṇaṃ hoti. tassa vedanāvipariṇām'ānuparivattijā paritassanā dhammasamuppādā cittaṃ pariyādāya tiṭṭhanti. cetaso pariyādānā uttāsavā ca hoti vighātavā ca apekkhavā ca upādāya ca paritassati.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso nigaṇṭhā, puriso sallena viddho assa savisena gāḷhapalepanena, so sallassa'pi vedanāhetu dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vediyeyya. tassa mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā bhisakkaṃ sallakattaṃ upaṭṭhāpeyyuṃ.
te ca h'āvuso, āyusaṅkhārā abhaviṃsu te vedaniyā dhammā, na'y'idaṃ saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpannassa bhikkhuno vuṭṭhānaṃ paññāyetha.
imesaṃ kho ahaṃ, bhikkhave, samaṇamalānaṃ samaṇadosānaṃ samaṇakasaṭānaṃ āpāyikānaṃ ṭhānānaṃ duggativedaniyānaṃ appahānā, na samaṇasāmīcippaṭipadaṃ paṭipanno'ti vadāmi.
yo ca kho, bhikkhave, evaṃ vadeyya, yathā yathā vedanīyaṃ ayaṃ puriso kammaṃ karoti tathā tathā'ssa vipākaṃ paṭisaṃvediyatī'ti
tathā hi ayam'āyasmā na c'eva gambhīraṃ atthapadaṃ udāharati santaṃ paṇītaṃ atakk'āvacaraṃ nipuṇaṃ paṇḍitavedanīyaṃ.

70292.meaning1: attached to feeling; attracted to feeling; engaged with felt experience

examples.text: vedan'upayaṃ… saññ'upayaṃ… saṅkhār'upayaṃ vā, bhikkhave, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭheyya, saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjeyya.

70293.meaning1: accumulation of feeling that is clung to

examples.text: katame c'āvuso, pañc'upādānakkhandhā? seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandho, vedan'upādānakkhandho, saññ'upādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandho.

kummo'ti kho, bhikkhu, pañcann'etaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ adhivacanaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, rūp'upādānakkhandhassa, vedan'upādānakkhandhassa, saññ'upādānakkhandhassa, saṅkhār'upādānakkhandhassa, viññāṇ'upādānakkhandhassa.

iti kho, bhikkhave, avijj'ūpanisā saṅkhārā, saṅkhār'ūpanisaṃ viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇ'ūpanisaṃ nāmarūpaṃ, nāmarūp'ūpanisaṃ saḷāyatanaṃ, saḷāyatan'ūpaniso phasso, phass'ūpanisā vedanā, vedan'ūpanisā taṇhā, taṇh'ūpanisaṃ upādānaṃ, upādān'ūpaniso bhavo, bhav'ūpanisā jāti, jāt'ūpanisaṃ dukkhaṃ, dukkh'ūpanisā saddhā, saddh'ūpanisaṃ pāmojjaṃ, pāmojj'ūpanisā pīti, pīt'ūpanisā passaddhi, passaddh'ūpanisaṃ sukhaṃ, sukh'ūpaniso samādhi, samādh'ūpanisaṃ yathābhūtañāṇadassanaṃ, yathābhūtañāṇadassan'ūpanisā nibbidā, nibbid'ūpaniso virāgo, virāg'ūpanisā vimutti, vimutt'ūpanisaṃ khayeñāṇaṃ.

70295.meaning1: accumulation of feeling that is clung to

examples.text: seyyath'īdaṃ rūp'ūpādānakkhandho, vedan'ūpādānakkhandho, saññ'ūpādānakkhandho, saṅkhār'ūpādānakkhandho, viññāṇ'ūpādānakkhandho

70296.meaning1: attached to feeling; attracted to sensation; engaged with felt experience

examples.text: vedan'ūpāyaṃ vā āvuso… saññ'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso… saṅkhār'ūpāyaṃ vā, āvuso, viññāṇaṃ tiṭṭhamānaṃ tiṭṭhati saṅkhār'ārammaṇaṃ saṅkhārappatiṭṭhaṃ nand'ūpasecanaṃ vuddhiṃ virūḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.

70297.meaning1: who has complete knowledge; epithet of an arahant
70297.meaning2: who excels in the knowledge of the Vedas
70297.meaningLit: gone to the end of the Vedas
70297.commentary: (SNa) ved'antagū'ti catunnaṃ maggavedānaṃ antaṃ, catūhi vā maggavedehi kilesānaṃ antaṃ gato.
70297.notes: Originally a Brahman term for someone with a complete knowledge of the Vedas.

examples.text: saccena danto damasā upeto, ved'antagū vusitabrahmacariyo, yaññ'opanīto tam'upavhayetha, kālena so juhati dakkhiṇeyye'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, rājā khattiyo muddh'āvasitto adhun'ābhisitto rajjena, uḷāraṃ so labhati vedapaṭilābhaṃ, uḷāraṃ so labhati somanassapaṭilābhaṃ.

70299.meaning2: who excels in the knowledge of the Vedas
